bio.text: Lateefah Simon has represented California's 12th Congressional District in the U.S. House since January 2025; the district includes parts of Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Emeryville, Oakland, Piedmont and San Leandro.
She was born in San Francisco in 1977, earned a bachelor's degree in public policy from Mills College (2009) and an M.P.A. from the University of San Francisco (2022).
At 19 she became executive director of the Young Women's Freedom Center, and she later led the Back on Track program with then-San Francisco District Attorney Kamala Harris.
She was elected to the Bay Area Rapid Transit board in 2016 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
